Context: In scene 1B a player typed 'Open the secured maintenance gate.' and 'Pick the lock on the maintenance gate.' after Brandon pointed at the gate. Neither fired a reveal, and the Jev semantic fallback never ran. Two causes.

FIX 1 (code, story-neutral). In storygame/runtime/cloudflare.py, CloudflareTurnProvider._semantic_authored_handoff skips a candidate when ANY of its `establishes` assert ops is already true (`any(operation.op == "assert" and _true(...))`). The runtime's own KnowledgeProjector._established (storygame/runtime/knowledge.py) uses ALL effects. Because k_sl_1b_b_r1 already asserts transport_route_identified, the later reveals k_sl_1b_c_r1 and k_sl_1b_c_r2 (which also assert it) were skipped, the eligible list was empty and Jev was never asked. Make the fallback skip a candidate only when ALL its establishes effects already hold, the same rule as _established (an assert is satisfied when the fact is true; do not reimplement differently: reuse or mirror _established's effect_matches semantics for assert and retract ops). Also read the other method near line 470-500 that builds the semantic no-clue rules (`_semantic_no_clue_rules` and the `eligible_count` loop); if it has the same any-skip, fix it the same way; if not, say so in notes.md. Add tests to tests/test_semantic_reveal_match.py in the style of the existing tests there: (a) a candidate whose establishes share ONE already-true fact with an earlier reveal but has another fact still false is still offered to the semantic ask; (b) a candidate whose establishes are ALL true is still skipped. Tests must be hermetic (no live model; use the stub ask the file already uses).

FIX 2 (authoring). In knowledge.yaml, id k_sl_1b_c_r1: the first action_evidence group is the verb group and today lacks open, unlock, pick. Add `open`, `unlock`, `pick` and `break`... NO: add exactly `open`, `unlock`, `pick` to the first (verb) group, and add `lock` to the second (object) group so 'Pick the lock on the maintenance gate.' matches. Also change its earn_when to: follows Brandon, flees or escapes through the maintenance gate, opens or unlocks the gate, or goes into the storm drain or the tunnel. Do not change k_sl_1b_c_r2 or any other id. Then extend the CASES dict in scripts/ringer/affordance/1b-wording-score.py (add only) with: 'Open the secured maintenance gate.': 'c_r1', 'Open the gate.': 'c_r1', 'Unlock the gate.': 'c_r1', 'Pick the lock on the maintenance gate.': 'c_r1'. Run `uv run python scripts/ringer/affordance/1b-wording-score.py` from the worktree root; every case, old and new, must pass, including the None cases. If a new verb makes an old None case fire, narrow the groups as little as needed and explain in notes.md.

Then run `TMPDIR=/tmp uv run pytest -q`, `uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format .` (ruff on Python only). Write notes.md at the worktree root: each edit with line numbers, the result of the no-clue-rules check, and any test string you updated.
